description: This file is a bundled JavaScript module exporting PostCSS plugin code related to 'postcss-flexbugs-fixes'. It contains functions and classes for CSS processing, including source map handling, CSS parsing, and plugin registration.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Represents CSS input with source map support, file info, and error handling.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Parses CSS source code into an AST, handling various CSS constructs.

classes.name: LazyResult
classes.description: Handles asynchronous processing of CSS with plugins, source maps, and error management.

classes.name: SourceMapGenerator
classes.description: Generates source maps for CSS files.

classes.name: SourceMapConsumer
classes.description: Consumes source maps for mapping generated code back to source.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root node of the CSS AST.

classes.name: Warning
classes.description: Represents a warning during CSS processing.

methods.name: postcss
methods.description: Main function to create a PostCSS processor with plugins.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses CSS source code into an AST.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes CSS with plugins, source maps, and error handling.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Converts AST back to CSS string.
